data.name: AI School Simulator
data.detailed_description:
═════════ ✿ ✿ ✿ Introduction ✿ ✿ ✿ ══════════

You’ve achieved what many only dream of.

You just got accepted in St. Mary’s Academy, one of the most prestigious international schools in the world. In this school, excellence is mandatory and failure of any kind has no place. The halls of this school have only known success through its long history.

St. Mary’s Academy is an elite institution reserved for the brightest and the most gifted students in the world. Do you have what it takes to prove yourself in this academy?

☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ FEATURES ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

═════════ ✿ ✿ ✿ ✿ ✿ ✿ ══════════

In this game, your classmates are AI controlled so all their dialogs will feel alive and they will make their own decisions based on the situation they find themselves in.

Talk to anyone. Influence everyone. Each character has:

  • Their own personality, goals, and secrets

  • Dynamic memory of their past interactions

  • Feelings towards each other

Play a game that is very unique from anything you have experienced before. Everyone you encounter in this game has their own needs, and most importantly, desires.

═════════ ✿ ✿ ✿ ✿ ✿ ✿ ══════════

Explore a fully interactive academy, and live your fantasy school life with our Scenario Editor:

  • Customize everyone in the class

  • Build friendships, relationships, or enemies

This game is designed to be fully modular. You will have the ability to set your own school scenarios, and the characters in it.

═════════ ✿ ✿ ✿ ✿ ✿ ✿ ══════════

  • The perfect student?

  • The unseen mastermind?

  • Or the one who brings the entire academy to its knees?

At St. Mary’s Academy…Everyone has a role. The question is—what will yours be?

data.short_description: Enter a prestigious academy filled with AI-powered students. Design and live your own fantasy school life: Fall in love, make friends, and inevitably make rivals.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet connection recommended for optimal AI response times.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
